# Reply-to-DM Campaign

DM the people who replied to one of your posts.

Use for messaging the people who replied to one of their posts. Not for a DM to one person.

**The user might say:** "Draft a short, personal DM for the people who replied to this post asking for what I offered, and tell me how to send it from Direct Messages: [post link]"

## Steps

1. The people who replied to the post, and who can be messaged.
   ```sh
   xholic dm preview-recipients --type FROM_TWEET --tweet-url <post link> --include-replies
   ```
2. Write the short, personal DM yourself.
3. Only when the user asks to send: create a draft campaign, set its steps, review it, show the outreach guidelines, and launch after they accept.
   ```sh
   xholic dm create-campaign --name <name> --delivery-mode ASSISTED
   ```
4. Then `xholic dm update-campaign`, `xholic dm review-campaign --id <id>` and `xholic dm launch-campaign --id <id> --confirmed-consent`.
